skillify: Turns a scraping task that just worked into a reusable, saved skill for next time.
slides: Creates presentation slides with charts, consistent styling, and persuasive writing.

sms: Plans text-message marketing flows like cart reminders and win-back texts.

sync-gbrain: Keeps the project's saved knowledge store up to date with the latest code.

vibe-map: Scans the project and updates a visual mind map showing its features, tech, and pending work.

website-to-video: Turns a general website into a tour or showcase video using screenshots of the site.

writing-plans: Turns a set of requirements into a step-by-step plan before any code gets written.
writing-skills: Guides how to create, edit, and test a skill before it's put into use.
